tasks.prompt: Use the role card. Say hello, your name, where you are from, and your partner's name. Record your own response.
Greet a new classmate. Introduce the name and place on the writing card. Use your own sentences.

audio.script: Hello. I am Lily. I am from New York.
Hello. I am Jack. I am from London.
Hello, Sam. I am Noah. You are Sam.

tasks.prompt: Use the speaking card. Say hello, introduce the name and place, then spell the name. Speak clearly at your own pace.
Use only the writing card. Introduce the name and place, then write the letters separately.

audio.script: Hello. I am Ed. E, D. I am from Hong Kong.
Hello, Tim. I am Kim. You are Tim.
Hello. I am Emma. I am from New York.

tasks.prompt: You meet the person on the card for the first time. Greet the person, introduce yourself and your place, and confirm the other name. Do not read a prepared script.
Write to the reader on the card. Greet the reader and introduce the writer and place. Add one sentence confirming the reader name.

audio.script: Hello, Adam. I am Sam. I am from London. You are Adam.
Hello. I am May. I am from Hong Kong.
Hello, Jo. I am Ben. You are from Los Angeles. I am from New York.

tasks.prompt: Make your own short introduction using the meeting card. Include a greeting and a sentence confirming who your new partner is. Record without reading a full model.
Use the writing card to greet the reader, introduce the writer and place, and confirm the reader name. Write independently and check the names.

audio.script: Hello, Kim. I am Leo. I am from Los Angeles.
Hello. I am Adam. I am from Hong Kong.
Hello, Eva. I am Noah. You are from London. I am from Los Angeles.

tasks.prompt: Use the object card. Identify the near item and the far item, then make the request. Record a clear response.
Identify the near object. Then write a request for both items and quantities on the message card.

audio.script: Hello, Ben. Two books, please. A bag, please.
Hello, Kim. A pen, please. Two bags, please.
Hello, Jo. This is an eraser. A book, please.

tasks.prompt: Use the request card. Say the items and quantities clearly. Make a polite request in your own recording.
Write a short request using the packing card. Keep the quantity and noun form for every item.

audio.script: Hello, Mia. A pen, please. Two bags, please.
Hello, Adam. Three books, please. A bag, please.
Hello, Eva. Two pens, please. A book, please.

tasks.prompt: Use the preparation card to tell a partner which items are near and far, then ask for the needed quantity. Make your own response.
Use the writing card. Identify the near object, then request both listed items and quantities.

audio.script: Hello, Mia. This is a bag. Two pens, please.
Hello, Jo. That is a book. A pen, please.
Hello, Adam. Three bags, please. Two books, please.

tasks.prompt: Use the new counter card. Identify the near and far items and request the needed quantity. Record independently without a full model.

Use only the writing card. Greet your partner, introduce yourself and where you are from, and confirm your partner's name. Identify the near object, then request the listed items and quantities. Check your note.

audio.script: Hello, Sam. This is a pen. Three books, please.
Hello, Kim. That is a bag. A book, please.
Hello, May. Two bags, please. A pen, please.
